name: Book Employee with Spouse — Spouse DOB Invalid Calendar Date
goal: User attempts to enter an invalid calendar date for spouse DOB, then corrects it.
constraints: First DOB input is invalid (e.g., 31 Feb 1990). Second input is valid and meets all age requirements.

phases.description: User initiates booking and selects 'Employee with Spouse'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot captures 'Employee with Spouse' as coverageType.

phases.description: User enters invalid spouse DOB; bot rejects and prompts again.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot replies with 'That doesn’t look like a valid date. Please enter a valid date of birth.'

phases.description: User enters valid spouse DOB; bot accepts.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts and stores DOB in DD MMM YYYY format.

phases.description: User completes rest of booking with valid inputs.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
